newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-O'CONNOR DEFIES ILLNESS TO CHALLENGE THE BEST.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-O'CONNOR DEFIES ILLNESS TO CHALLENGE THE BEST.

text.p: THAME, England, May 9 Reuter) - Christy O'Connor's challenging first round 68 in the Benson and Hedges International was a triumph over a debilitating muscular injury that had threatened to put him out of the game for good.
Even now O'Connor has to wear strapping on his left arm to enable him to play -- and his relief as he took it off after completing his round was patent.
"I wear a tight band on the arm to disperse the pain and you have to wear it very tight. It is very uncomfortable.
But it's working and I've talked myself out of being sore," said the 48-year-old Irishman, one of the great characters in professional golf over the past 25 years.
O'Connor's problems began in November 1995 when he developed tennis elbow and the condition became progressively worse.
"If I put on any power and squeezed the hand, I felt it. I couldn't even squeeze a tube of toothpaste."
As the muscle wasted away, Conor O'Brien, the Irish Olympic team doctor, prescribed laser treatment.
"Laser treatment is very sore, like placing your hand on a red hot grill. It touches you about 100 times and you're black from the burns.
"The burning effect lasts for two days. You can smell the skin burning, it sparks and it's pretty awful."
But if he was going to play golf again O'Connor, best remembered for his dramatic win over Fred Couples in the 1989 Ryder Cup, knew he had to go through with the treatment.
"After 27 years on the Tour, how do you give it up? My family is steeped in golf and the whole house is about golf. I was the only one in the house not playing golf.
"I thought at first it was a good excuse to take a week off but I missed the crack.
"I was 50 pounds (23 kilos) worse off in muscle power in the left hand compared with the right and he said it was very serious. Now I've built it back to only 15 pounds worse."
O'Connor rejoined the European Tour for the Desert Classic in Dubai in February and played all four rounds. After missing the cut in the Moroccan Open he entered the Italian Open.
"I played pretty nicely in Italy, hitting the ball well and driving straight and putting nicely.
